$comment: Editora's offline package.json schema: the fields npm, Node.js and the common package managers read.
title: package.json

name.description: The package name: lowercase, no spaces, at most 214 characters, optionally @scope/name.

version.description: The version, in a form node-semver can parse (1.2.3).

description.description: What the package is, shown by npm search.

keywords.description: Words npm search finds the package by.

license.description: The license, as an SPDX expression (MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC) or "UNLICENSED".

files.description: The files the published package holds.

main.description: The module loaded by require("name") when exports is not given.

module.description: The ES module entry bundlers read.

browser.description: The entry, or replacements, for browser bundles.

bin.description: Commands the package installs, by name.

dev.description: Starts a development build or server (npm run dev).

prepare.description: Runs on a local npm install and before the package is packed.

prepack.description: Runs before the tarball is packed.

postpack.description: Runs after the tarball is packed.

preinstall.description: Runs before the package is installed.

install.description: Runs when the package is installed.

postinstall.description: Runs after the package is installed.

version.description: Runs after npm version bumps the version, before the commit.

dependencies.description: Packages the package needs to run, by name: version range.

devDependencies.description: Packages needed only to develop and build it.

peerDependencies.description: Packages the host project must provide.

optionalDependencies.description: Packages installed when they can be; their failure does not fail the install.

overrides.description: Versions npm uses instead of the ones dependencies ask for.

resolutions.description: Versions Yarn uses instead of the ones dependencies ask for.

engines.description: The Node.js (and npm) versions the package runs on.

private.description: true: npm refuses to publish the package.

type.description: How Node.js reads .js files here: "module" (ES modules) or "commonjs" (the default).

exports.description: The package's entry points, by subpath and condition.

packageManager.description: The package manager and exact version this project uses (pnpm@9.1.0), as Corepack reads it.

sideEffects.description: false: bundlers may drop unused modules of the package.
